paragraphs: CenterEdge sells point-of-sale and cashless technology, secure payment processing and hands-on business mentoring to multi-attraction entertainment centers and amusement parks. Its point of sale product, Advantage Sales, is aimed at family and location-based entertainment centers, amusement parks and waterparks.

Staff sell admissions and attractions, packages and promotions from the same screens. Value and entitlements are printed on tickets or wristbands, or added to reusable media such as magstripe cards and lanyards. Operators can build season passes, bounceback admission passes, attraction bundles and multi-site passes. Admissions, attractions and parties can also be sold online through an integrated system that manages online and on-premise sales and capacities. Food and beverage runs on the same system, whether a venue offers full-service dining or quick-service fast casual, covering sales, preparation, fulfillment and inventory. Mobile ordering arrives through an integration with the food and beverage software partner Truffle.

The company says its pricing carries no hidden fees or complicated pricing structures. It frames the business around the belief that great entertainment businesses build great communities. A Hybrid Tablet gives staff full access to the Advantage software suite anywhere in the park.
